bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. SCHIFF:
H.R. 3875.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
The Telephone Metadata Reform Act is constitutionally
authorized under Article I, Section 8, Clause 3, the Commerce
Clause and Article I, Section 8, Clause 18, the Necessary and
Proper Clause. Additionally, the Preamble to the Constitution
provides support of the authority to enact legislation to
promote the General Welfare.
[Page H224]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Crime, Terrorism, Homeland Security, and Investigations.
